parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID, name, max phase, type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL5291721. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Use LEFT JOIN compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
